_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) on your server and fill in. This file lives ONLY on the server - never on the phone. It holds your card, so keep the server private and HTTPS-only.
_api_token_help: Shared secret the phone sends as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"

payment._comment: Required for the iPhone app (it pays unattended). The form is filled and the order total is read back; if it exceeds max_charge_nzd the payment is REFUSED as a safety rail.

safety._max_charge_help: Refuse to submit RUC payment if NZTA's order total is above this. Set a bit above one top-up's real cost to catch surprises (wrong units, rate changes).
safety._estimate_help: Rough $/1000km shown in the app for confirmation BEFORE buying. Update to the current NZTA rate for your vehicle type; it's only a display estimate, NZTA charges the real amount.

rego._comment: Vehicle licensing (rego) renewal. Like RUC, it fills the form, reads the real total and refuses to pay above max_charge_nzd.

reminders._comment: WoF + rego expiry reminders. The in-app status panel always works. Email is sent only if the smtp block below is filled in.

smtp._comment: OPTIONAL. Fill in to enable email reminders. For Gmail use an App Password, not your normal password.

vapid._comment: OPTIONAL. Fill in to enable iPhone push notifications. Generate with: python make_vapid.py (then paste the three values). subject must be a mailto: you control.
vapid.subject: mailto:you@example.com
